workspace.contextHelp: Text from this area is captured when you send. Images require explicit attachments. No screen capture, local paths, credentials or workflow graphs.
workspace.suggestionHelp: Review against the current Studio setup before applying. No render starts.
workspace.reviewHelp: Show current and proposed values before Apply.
workspace.suggestionStale: Studio changed. Review again before applying or undoing.
workspace.suggestionInvalid: These values are unsupported by the current controls.
workspace.undoHelp: Restore the previous values only if Studio has not changed since Apply.
workspace.allowRender: Allow image generation for this message
workspace.allowRenderHelp: Explicit permission for this message only. Advice and context alone cannot render.
